integrity: An analytic proof establishes all horizons; included finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroboration only. No third-party certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Static, complete, disjoint two-party approvals only; not a general-price theorem for temporal voting. Discrete horizon maxima derive from the published party-list lower-quota equivalence. Possible related apportionment formulations remain a publication-priority risk.
title: Exact horizon-wise welfare price of two-party FJR+ in temporal voting
